arguments.sql:
SELECT d."XCL_038", d."XCL_039"
FROM drivers AS d
WHERE d."XCL_034" IN (
  SELECT q."XCL_058"
  FROM qualifying AS q
  WHERE q."XCL_057" = (
    SELECT r."XCL_065"
    FROM races AS r
    WHERE r."XCL_069" = 'Spanish Grand Prix'
      AND r."XCL_066" = 2011
  )
    AND q."XCL_062" IS NOT NULL
  ORDER BY (
    CAST(SUBSTRING(q."XCL_062", 1, INSTR(q."XCL_062", ':') - 1) AS REAL) * 60
  ) + (
    CAST(SUBSTRING(q."XCL_062", INSTR(q."XCL_062", ':') + 1, INSTR(q."XCL_062", '.') - INSTR(q."XCL_062", ':') - 1) AS REAL)
  ) + (
    CAST(SUBSTRING(q."XCL_062", INSTR(q."XCL_062", '.') + 1) AS REAL) / 1000
  ) DESC
  LIMIT 5
)
AND EXISTS (
  SELECT 1
  FROM lapTimes AS lt
  WHERE lt."XCL_044" = d."XCL_034"
    AND (
      CAST(SUBSTRING(lt."XCL_047", 1, INSTR(lt."XCL_047", ':') - 1) AS REAL) * 60
    ) + (
      CAST(SUBSTRING(lt."XCL_047", INSTR(lt."XCL_047", ':') + 1, INSTR(lt."XCL_047", '.') - INSTR(lt."XCL_047", ':') - 1) AS REAL)
    ) + (
      CAST(SUBSTRING(lt."XCL_047", INSTR(lt."XCL_047", '.') + 1) AS REAL) / 1000
    ) < 90
)
